DETECTIVAL Metal Detecting rally in the U.K
DETECTIVAL: The UK's Premier Metal Detecting Event

Welcome to the DETECTIVAL Page, one of Europe’s largest and most anticipated Yearly metal detecting rallies. Detectival bring together enthusiasts from around the globe for an unforgettable weekend of history, community, and discovery in the United Kingdom.
LIVE footage from Detectival and the finding of the Hambledon Hoard

HISTORY MADE LIVE: The Hambledon Hoard In 2019, the atmosphere at Detectival UK changed forever. Right there in the fields, amidst the buzz of the rally, the Hambledon Hoard was unearthed LIVE. Participants watched in awe as 12 Gold Coins and over 600 Silver Hammered Coins saw sunlight for the first time in centuries. It wasn't just a find; it was a phenomenon.
Hambledon hoard 2019 live footage of treasure finds

WATCH: The Hambledon Hoard Discovery LIVE 🎥 Relive the chaos and the glory of Detectival 2019. Watch the raw reaction footage as the "Hambledon Hoard" is unearthed—featuring the discovery of 12 Gold Coins and over 600 Silver Hammered Coins. This is what metal detecting is all about.
